writ, to me directed and delivered, I will expose the sale at

of the said day at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue,
New Brunswick, NJ 08901.
The Property to be sold is located in the Township of Old
Bridge, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey.

Woods" situate in the Township of Madison, County of Middlesex, New Jersey, dated May 3, 1973 and revised July 18,
1973 and filed on January 29, 1974 as Map no. 3704.
(This concise description does not constitute a legal
description. A copy of the full legal description can be found
at the Office of the Sheriff.)

$142.77 OPEN PLUS PENALTY. Chicago Title Insurance Company agrees to indemnify Judgment# DJ-052511-2004 in favor of RJM ACQUISITIONS LLC dated 3/4/04 in the amount of $1,959.11 and Judgment# DJ-126167-2005 in favor of
INTERGRATED ALARMS SYSTEMS INC dated 5/17/05 in the
amount of $1,108.40. Deponent does not warrant the accuracy of this representation and herein makes no representation regarding the status of title. Interested parties are advised to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether there exists any outstanding interests or amounts due.
*SURPLUS MONEY If after the sale and satisfaction of the
morhortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the
surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to
Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent
of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the the sale will have information regarding the
surplus, if any.
The sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn thisis sale
without further notice through publication.
Upset Price: Approximately: $1,319,976.00 and any additional
sums as ordered by the court
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the
Clerk of Middlesex County. The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of ONEMILLION
ONE HUNDRED SEVENTY SEVEN THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED
EIGHTEEN AND 08/100
dollars
($1,177,118.08)
more or less, plus interest together with the costs of
this sale. The upset amount may be subject to further orders of additional sums.
A subscriber reserves the right to adjourn said sale from
time to time subject only to such limitations or restrictions
upon the exercise of such power as may be specially provided by law or rules of the Court. Sold subject to conditions
of sale. Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid a certified check or official bank check at close of sale and the balance within two weeks.
